passages.title: A Family Trip to Tongyeong: Day Two
text: Early in the morning, we went to Dongpirang.
There were many pretty paintings on the walls.
It was the best place for taking pictures!
Mom and I took hundreds of pictures.
Finally, my dad said, “Please stop! No more pictures!”
Next, we went to the Jeon Hyuck-lim Museum of Art.
The painter’s nickname is ‘The Magician of Color.’
He painted the sea of Tongyeong with various blue colors.
I enjoyed his paintings very much.
Going on a family trip is always fun.
koreanText: 엄마와 나는 수백 장의 사진을 찍었다.
마침내, 나의 아빠가 “제발 그만! 더 이상의 사진은 안 돼!”라고 말씀하셨다.
그는 통영의 바다를 다양한 푸른색으로 칠했다.
나는 그의 그림들을 아주 많이 즐겼다.
가족 여행을 가는 것은 언제나 재미있다.
